claim_map.claim: The six routes are narrower continuous descriptors under Conscientiousness, not personality types.
Facet interest or attention is not equivalent to ability, diagnosis, or outcome prediction.
This route taxonomy must not be directly converted to BFI-2 facets or BFAS aspects.

competence.construct_summary: the usual confidence that one can understand requirements, organize action, and handle everyday tasks effectively
competence.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not actual ability, intelligence, credentials, or a confidence slogan. A skilled person can underestimate capacity, while high subjective confidence can coexist with missing knowledge; task evidence remains necessary

order.construct_summary: the usual preference for classification, arrangement, tidiness, sequence, and predictable work structures
order.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not obsessive-compulsive disorder, cleanliness, perfectionism, or work quality. A neat desk does not establish this facet, a cluttered setting does not prove poor delivery, and a personality page cannot infer a clinical condition

dutifulness.construct_summary: the usual importance placed on commitments, responsibilities, reasons for rules, and reasonable expectations from others
dutifulness.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not obedience to authority, people-pleasing, moral worth, or never saying no. Responsibility includes challenging unreasonable demands, protecting boundaries, and renegotiating when conditions change

achievement-striving.construct_summary: the usual tendency to invest effort in demanding standards, improvement goals, and challenging outcomes
achievement-striving.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not social status, income, busyness, competition, or eventual achievement. Opportunity, resources, health, caregiving, and team conditions affect outcomes; lower striving does not establish laziness or lack of values

self-discipline.construct_summary: the usual tendency to begin and sustain action toward a reasonable completion point when a task is dull, difficult, or slow to reward
self-discipline.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not moral willpower, laziness, an executive-function diagnosis, or permanent productivity. Sleep, stress, caregiving, environmental friction, and health affect initiation; this page cannot infer ADHD or another clinical condition

deliberation.construct_summary: the usual tendency to consider consequences, alternatives, risk, and reversibility before acting or committing
deliberation.explicit_non_equivalence: It is not indecision, anxiety, intelligence, or refusal to take risk. Considering more does not guarantee a correct conclusion, and deciding quickly is not necessarily impulsive

limitations: The frozen CMS taxonomy is NEO/IPIP-like; it is not claimed as the single universal Big Five facet standard.
No proprietary assessment items, scoring keys, norms, or copyrighted manual text are reproduced.
No reliability, validity, percentile, clinical, hiring, admission, salary, relationship-outcome, or deterministic career claim is made.
